name: Target Lens
description: Customizable target HUD: buffs/debuffs, threat/aggro, boss skill timers and a live cast bar.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Target overlays in a boss fight — HP + break gauge, the effect list (★ = your own), threat/aggro %, and the cast bar.
Grouped settings — display style, effect-source filters, threat, cast bar and boss timers.

added: Target HUD — see your current target's HP, shield and break/stagger gauge, plus its name, level, rank and distance.

Buff & debuff tracker — every effect on the target with icons and timers. Show it as tiles on the HUD, a separate resizable list, or turn it off. Filter by who applied it (you, other players, or the monster itself), mark your own with a star, hide permanent effects, and pick exactly which effects appear — with a recommended list pinned to the top.
Threat / Aggro — see who has the boss's attention and each player's threat share, with your own row highlighted.
Boss Skill Timers — countdowns to a boss's dangerous skills so you can react in time.
Cast bar — watch your target channel a skill in real time.
Fully customizable — every overlay drags and resizes and remembers its place; settings grouped by section; available in English, Japanese, Thai, Indonesian and Filipino.
